TerminalPreferences.Title: Terminal appearance
TerminalPreferences.Description: Customize all terminal tabs. Changes are applied and remembered when you save.
TerminalPreferences.FontHint: Fira Code is included. Other choices use monospaced fonts available on this PC.
TerminalPreferences.LigaturesHint: Combine operators such as !=, => and === visually while preserving the original text and terminal cells.
TerminalPreferences.BoldBright: Use bright ANSI colors for bold text
TerminalPreferences.PaletteHint: Presets change colors only. The first eight ANSI entries are normal colors; the last eight are bright colors.
TerminalPreferences.CursorHint: These cursor defaults can be changed by remote applications. Selection transparency applies to the terminal selection.
TerminalPreferences.ScrollbackHint: Keep between 500 and 10,000 lines per terminal. Reducing this limit immediately removes the oldest excess lines. More history uses more memory in each tab.
TerminalPreferences.PrivacyHint: Only appearance preferences are saved. Terminal contents, commands, and credentials are never included in this file.
TerminalPreferences.InvalidValue: Check the settings. Colors must use #RRGGBB and numeric values must stay within the displayed limits.
TerminalPreferences.SaveFailed: The terminal preferences could not be saved. Check access to the application settings folder and try again.
